senses.gloss: c. (v. <cite ref="M02034"><he>מִסְּתָא</he></cite>; a phrase borrowed fr.
units: Deut. XVI, 10; 17, v. Targ. Y.; = h. כְּדָיי) adequate, able, worthy.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Leviticus 23:29">Targ. Y. II, Lev. XXIII, 29</cite> <he>דכ׳ וכ׳</he> that is able (or of adequate age) to fast.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 20:16">Targ. Y. Gen. XX, 16</cite>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 7:18">Targ. II Sam. VII, 18</cite>; <cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 17:16">Targ. I Chr. XVII, 16</cite> <he>לית אנא כ׳</he> I am not worthy (h. text <he>מי אנכי</he>).
